headline: Palo Alto announces continuous frontier-model offensive security service with unverified efficacy
summary: On September 22, 2026, Palo Alto Networks announced Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense as a worldwide annual-subscription service. The company describes a full-estate baseline scan followed by recurring testing as customer environments change, using a proprietary harness that routes work among gated frontier and open-weight models, threat intelligence and offensive-security staff. It says the service validates attack paths across applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, repositories and network assets, then prioritizes remediation. The release reports customer findings but supplies no assessment denominator, independent validation or measured remediation outcome; the announcement supports product availability and described design, not service efficacy.
